<Heading

  children={"Register a physical facility"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/sites"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Adds a Site to the warehouse map. The site code becomes the first segment of every LocationCode inside the facility, so it must be uppercase alphanumeric and unique across the service. Site code uniqueness is enforced here in the application layer rather than in the aggregate: a single aggregate cannot see its siblings. A newly registered Site is Active, and publishes SiteRegistered.

`siteRole` (ADR-0037) is optional: omitted means `UNSPECIFIED`. An unknown role is 422 `invalid-site-role`. The role never sets the transfer capability (ADR-0035 stays the only writer; see `GET /site-roles/transfer-defaults` for the per-role defaults).

`gln` (ADR-0045) is an optional GS1 Global Location Number. It must be 13 digits ending in the GS1 mod-10 check digit (otherwise 422 `invalid-gln`) and a GLN identifies exactly one location across sites, zones and slots (otherwise 409 `gln-already-assigned`). A site registered without a `gln` is exactly as valid as before.

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Caller-generated key (a UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters) that makes a retried POST safe (ADR 0019, ADR 0044). Clients MUST always send it: the service runs on Postgres in every deployment (ADR 0039), so the header is always enforced and an absent key is answered 400 `idempotency-key-required`, a malformed one 400 `idempotency-key-invalid`. A replay with the same key, method, path and body returns the original response verbatim plus the response header `Idempotency-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 `idempotency-key-reused`. The key is global (not per route).","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128,"example":"5b0f6a0e-6a41-4c63-9f33-0c8f5c1d2a77"}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
